blocks.p: Angel Cross pumped gas at the Fossoil station. Six days in, he takes stock of what he can do in two tabs of the *Character* window: *Skills*, in Figure 2-1, and *Identity*, in Figure 2-2.

The *Skills* tab lists every skill by group, such as *Combat - Firearms*, *Crafting* and *Farming*. Each skill shows its level at the left and a bar at the right. A skill that gains experience faster than usual carries a tag with its boost, such as *+125% XP*. Angel's Mechanics is at 7 and his Welding at 6; his Cooking is still at 2.

marks.text: Mechanics at 7, with a +125% XP boost.

sticky.text: Six days in: Mechanics 7, Welding 6, Cooking 2.

blocks.p: The *Identity* tab holds your character's ID card: name, weight, sex, profession, hair style and color, body and facial hair, how long you have survived, your favorite weapon and the number of zombies you have killed.
Under the card, *Hair and beard* sets your look as it is, *Now*, beside the look a pick gives, *After*. Click *Hair* or *Beard* to choose which one you style. *Shave* needs a razor or scissors.
*Traits* lists your positive traits and your negative ones. Each trait ends in a square mark: green for a positive trait, red for a negative one.

marks.text: A mechanic, six days in, 37 zombies killed.
Hair and beard: Now is your look, After previews a pick.
Good traits carry a green mark.
Bad ones carry a red mark.
